title: Per-Developer Environments Meet AI Agent Reality
excerpt: For years, teams pursued per-developer environments as the ultimate DevOps goal. AI agents have fundamentally changed this landscape, creating a new requirement: per-agent-per-task environments that multiply faster than infrastructure can handle.
post_draft:
What if your infrastructure strategy just became obsolete?

For years, we chased the holy grail of per-developer environments. Teams invested heavily in this approach. It worked. It scaled. Then AI agents arrived and changed everything.

Now we're facing a new problem: per-agent-per-task environments that spin up faster than your infrastructure can handle. Each task needs its own isolated space. Each agent multiplies the demand. The math doesn't work anymore.

We're at an inflection point. The DevOps playbook that worked yesterday won't work tomorrow. Teams need to rethink environment management from the ground up.

Read our latest piece to understand why this shift matters for your testing and security strategy—and what you should be thinking about now.
